-- National generation mix per half hour, as a percentage of generation by fuel.
with source as (
    select * from "energy"."raw"."generation_mix"
),

typed as (
    select
        coalesce(
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ'),
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M')) as period_start_utc,
        try_cast(biomass_perc as double) as biomass_pct,
        try_cast(coal_perc as double) as coal_pct,
        try_cast(imports_perc as double) as imports_pct,
        try_cast(gas_perc as double) as gas_pct,
        try_cast(nuclear_perc as double) as nuclear_pct,
        try_cast(other_perc as double) as other_pct,
        try_cast(hydro_perc as double) as hydro_pct,
        try_cast(solar_perc as double) as solar_pct,
        try_cast(wind_perc as double) as wind_pct,
        _source_file,
        _loaded_at
    from source
)

select *
from typed
where period_start_utc is not null
qualify row_number() over (partition by period_start_utc order by _loaded_at desc, _source_file desc) = 1

-- Regional carbon intensity per half hour and region. The API only publishes
-- forecasts (no "actual") at regional level.
with source as (
    select * from "energy"."raw"."carbon_regional"
),

typed as (
    select
        coalesce(
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ'),
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M')) as period_start_utc,
        try_cast(regionid as integer) as region_id,
        trim(shortname) as region_short_name,
        trim(dnoregion) as dno_region,
        cast(round(try_cast(forecast as double)) as integer) as intensity_forecast,
        lower(trim("index")) as intensity_index,
        try_cast(biomass_perc as double) as biomass_pct,
        try_cast(coal_perc as double) as coal_pct,
        try_cast(imports_perc as double) as imports_pct,
        try_cast(gas_perc as double) as gas_pct,
        try_cast(nuclear_perc as double) as nuclear_pct,
        try_cast(other_perc as double) as other_pct,
        try_cast(hydro_perc as double) as hydro_pct,
        try_cast(solar_perc as double) as solar_pct,
        try_cast(wind_perc as double) as wind_pct,
        _source_file,
        _loaded_at
    from source
)

select *
from typed
where period_start_utc is not null
qualify row_number() over (partition by period_start_utc, region_id order by _loaded_at desc, _source_file desc) = 1

-- National carbon intensity per half hour. The API reports both a forecast and
-- (after the event) an actual estimate, in grams of CO2 per kWh.
with source as (
    select * from "energy"."raw"."carbon_national"
),

typed as (
    select
        coalesce(
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ'),
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
        try_strptime("from", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M')) as period_start_utc,
        coalesce(
        try_strptime("to", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ'),
        try_strptime("to", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
        try_strptime("to", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M')) as period_end_utc,
        cast(round(try_cast(forecast as double)) as integer) as intensity_forecast,
        cast(round(try_cast(actual as double)) as integer) as intensity_actual,
        lower(trim("index")) as intensity_index,
        _source_file,
        _loaded_at
    from source
)

select *
from typed
where period_start_utc is not null
qualify row_number() over (partition by period_start_utc order by _loaded_at desc, _source_file desc) = 1

-- UK bank holidays by division (england-and-wales, scotland, northern-ireland).
with source as (
    select * from "energy"."raw"."bank_holidays"
)

select distinct
    trim(division) as division,
    try_cast("date" as date) as holiday_date,
    trim(title) as holiday_name
from source
where try_cast("date" as date) is not null

-- Hourly observed weather per city (Open-Meteo reanalysis, times in UTC).
with source as (
    select * from "energy"."raw"."weather_hourly"
),

typed as (
    select
        try_strptime("time", '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M') as observed_at_utc,
        trim(city) as city,
        try_cast(temperature_2m as double) as temperature_c,
        try_cast(wind_speed_10m as double) as wind_speed_kmh,
        try_cast(shortwave_radiation as double) as solar_radiation_wm2,
        try_cast(cloud_cover as double) as cloud_cover_pct,
        _source_file,
        _loaded_at
    from source
)

select *
from typed
where observed_at_utc is not null
qualify row_number() over (partition by observed_at_utc, city order by _loaded_at desc, _source_file desc) = 1

-- One row per settlement period from the NESO demand files, with text cast to
-- proper types. Rows that appear in more than one file keep the latest file.
with source as (
    select * from "energy"."raw"."neso_demand"
),

typed as (
    select
        trim(settlement_date) as settlement_date_raw,
        case
            -- Newer files: 2025-01-31 (sometimes with a time part)
            when regexp_matches(trim(settlement_date), '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}')
                then try_cast(substr(trim(settlement_date), 1, 10) as date)
            -- 2023 file: 31-Jan-23 (two-digit year)
            when regexp_matches(trim(settlement_date), '^\d{1,2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}$')
                then make_date(
                    2000 + try_cast(split_part(trim(settlement_date), '-', 3) as bigint),
                    cast(list_position(['JAN','FEB','MAR','APR','MAY','JUN','JUL','AUG','SEP','OCT','NOV','DEC'],
                                       upper(split_part(trim(settlement_date), '-', 2))) as bigint),
                    try_cast(split_part(trim(settlement_date), '-', 1) as bigint))
            -- 2024 file: 31-JAN-2024
            when regexp_matches(trim(settlement_date), '^\d{1,2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{4}$')
                then make_date(
                    try_cast(split_part(trim(settlement_date), '-', 3) as bigint),
                    cast(list_position(['JAN','FEB','MAR','APR','MAY','JUN','JUL','AUG','SEP','OCT','NOV','DEC'],
                                       upper(split_part(trim(settlement_date), '-', 2))) as bigint),
                    try_cast(split_part(trim(settlement_date), '-', 1) as bigint))
        end as settlement_date,
        try_cast(settlement_period as integer) as settlement_period,
        try_cast(nd as double) as national_demand_mw,
        try_cast(tsd as double) as transmission_system_demand_mw,
        try_cast(england_wales_demand as double) as england_wales_demand_mw,
        try_cast(embedded_wind_generation as double) as embedded_wind_mw,
        try_cast(embedded_wind_capacity as double) as embedded_wind_capacity_mw,
        try_cast(embedded_solar_generation as double) as embedded_solar_mw,
        try_cast(embedded_solar_capacity as double) as embedded_solar_capacity_mw,
        try_cast(non_bm_stor as double) as non_bm_stor_mw,
        try_cast(pump_storage_pumping as double) as pump_storage_pumping_mw,
        try_cast(scottish_transfer as double) as scottish_transfer_mw,
        try_cast(ifa_flow as double) as ifa_flow_mw,
        try_cast(ifa2_flow as double) as ifa2_flow_mw,
        try_cast(britned_flow as double) as britned_flow_mw,
        try_cast(moyle_flow as double) as moyle_flow_mw,
        try_cast(east_west_flow as double) as east_west_flow_mw,
        try_cast(nemo_flow as double) as nemo_flow_mw,
        try_cast(nsl_flow as double) as nsl_flow_mw,
        try_cast(eleclink_flow as double) as eleclink_flow_mw,
        try_cast(viking_flow as double) as viking_flow_mw,
        try_cast(greenlink_flow as double) as greenlink_flow_mw,
        coalesce(upper(trim(forecast_actual_indicator)) = 'F', false) as is_forecast,
        _source_file,
        _loaded_at
    from source
)

select *
from typed
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by settlement_date, settlement_period
    order by _source_file desc, _loaded_at desc
) = 1

-- Warn when the national carbon series skips half hours (the public API
-- occasionally has short outages). Returns each gap with its length.
with ordered as (
    select
        period_start_utc,
        lead(period_start_utc) over (order by period_start_utc) as next_start
    from "energy"."staging"."stg_carbon__national_intensity"
)

select
    period_start_utc as gap_after,
    next_start,
    date_diff('minute', period_start_utc, next_start) / 30 - 1 as missing_periods
from ordered
where next_start is not null
  and date_diff('minute', period_start_utc, next_start) <> 30

-- Carbon Intensity API regions (from the seed file).
select region_id, region_name, region_type, nation
from "energy"."reference"."regions"

-- National carbon intensity joined to the generation mix for each half hour,
-- with simple grouped shares that are easier to explain than nine fuels.
select
    i.period_start_utc,
    i.intensity_actual,
    i.intensity_forecast,
    i.intensity_index,
    m.wind_pct,
    m.solar_pct,
    m.nuclear_pct,
    m.hydro_pct,
    m.biomass_pct,
    m.gas_pct,
    m.coal_pct,
    m.imports_pct,
    m.other_pct,
    m.wind_pct + m.solar_pct as wind_solar_pct,
    m.wind_pct + m.solar_pct + m.nuclear_pct + m.hydro_pct as zero_carbon_pct,
    m.gas_pct + m.coal_pct as fossil_pct
from "energy"."staging"."stg_carbon__national_intensity" as i
left join "energy"."staging"."stg_carbon__generation_mix" as m
    on m.period_start_utc = i.period_start_utc

select region_id

-- A single GB weather series: population-weighted average of the city
-- readings for each hour, then repeated for both half hours in that hour.
with weights as (
    select city, population_weight_m from "energy"."reference"."cities"
),

hourly as (
    select
        w.observed_at_utc,
        sum(w.temperature_c * c.population_weight_m) / sum(c.population_weight_m) as temperature_c,
        sum(w.wind_speed_kmh * c.population_weight_m) / sum(c.population_weight_m) as wind_speed_kmh,
        sum(w.solar_radiation_wm2 * c.population_weight_m) / sum(c.population_weight_m) as solar_radiation_wm2,
        sum(w.cloud_cover_pct * c.population_weight_m) / sum(c.population_weight_m) as cloud_cover_pct,
        count(*) as cities_reporting
    from "energy"."staging"."stg_weather__hourly" as w
    join weights as c on c.city = w.city
    where w.temperature_c is not null
    group by w.observed_at_utc
)

select observed_at_utc as period_start_utc, temperature_c, wind_speed_kmh,
       solar_radiation_wm2, cloud_cover_pct, cities_reporting
from hourly
union all
select observed_at_utc + interval 30 minute, temperature_c, wind_speed_kmh,
       solar_radiation_wm2, cloud_cover_pct, cities_reporting
from hourly

-- Outturn (actual) demand per settlement period, with the correct UTC and UK
-- local start time for each period, including the 46- and 50-period days.
with demand as (
    select *
    from "energy"."staging"."stg_neso__demand"
    where not is_forecast
      and settlement_date is not null
      and settlement_period between 1 and 50
      and national_demand_mw is not null
)

select
    settlement_date,
    settlement_period,
    (timezone('UTC', timezone('Europe/London', cast(settlement_date as timestamp)))
        + to_minutes(cast((settlement_period - 1) * 30 as bigint))) as period_start_utc,
    timezone('Europe/London', timezone('UTC', (timezone('UTC', timezone('Europe/London', cast(settlement_date as timestamp)))
        + to_minutes(cast((settlement_period - 1) * 30 as bigint))))) as period_start_local,
    national_demand_mw,
    transmission_system_demand_mw,
    england_wales_demand_mw,
    embedded_wind_mw,
    embedded_wind_capacity_mw,
    embedded_solar_mw,
    embedded_solar_capacity_mw,
    pump_storage_pumping_mw,
    -- National Demand excludes generation on local networks, so add the NESO
    -- embedded wind and solar estimates back to approximate underlying demand.
    national_demand_mw + coalesce(embedded_wind_mw, 0) + coalesce(embedded_solar_mw, 0) as underlying_demand_mw,
    coalesce(ifa_flow_mw, 0) + coalesce(ifa2_flow_mw, 0) + coalesce(britned_flow_mw, 0)
        + coalesce(moyle_flow_mw, 0) + coalesce(east_west_flow_mw, 0) + coalesce(nemo_flow_mw, 0)
        + coalesce(nsl_flow_mw, 0) + coalesce(eleclink_flow_mw, 0) + coalesce(viking_flow_mw, 0)
        + coalesce(greenlink_flow_mw, 0) as net_interconnector_flow_mw
from demand

-- Every complete day must have exactly the number of settlement periods the
-- UK clock implies: 48 normally, 46 when the clocks go forward, 50 when they
-- go back. The newest day is skipped because it may still be filling in.
with per_day as (
    select settlement_date, count(*) as periods, max(settlement_period) as max_period
    from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly"
    group by settlement_date
),

checked as (
    select
        settlement_date,
        periods,
        max_period,
        cast(date_diff('minute',
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(settlement_date as timestamp)),
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(settlement_date + 1 as timestamp))) / 30 as integer) as expected
    from per_day
    where settlement_date < (select max(settlement_date) from per_day)
)

select *
from checked
where periods <> expected or max_period <> expected

from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly"
where period_start_utc is null

select settlement_date, settlement_period, count(*) as row_count

from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly"

group by period_start_utc
having count(*) > 1

-- Regional carbon intensity. Grain: one row per region per half hour.
select
    r.period_start_utc,
    timezone('Europe/London', timezone('UTC', r.period_start_utc)) as period_start_local,
    cast(timezone('Europe/London', timezone('UTC', r.period_start_utc)) as date) as local_date,
    r.region_id,
    r.intensity_forecast,
    r.intensity_index,
    r.wind_pct,
    r.solar_pct,
    r.nuclear_pct,
    r.hydro_pct,
    r.biomass_pct,
    r.gas_pct,
    r.coal_pct,
    r.imports_pct,
    r.other_pct,
    r.wind_pct + r.solar_pct + r.nuclear_pct + r.hydro_pct as zero_carbon_pct
from "energy"."staging"."stg_carbon__regional" as r

-- One row per calendar day covered by the demand data, with calendar
-- attributes, bank holidays and clock-change flags.
with bounds as (
    select min(settlement_date) as first_day, max(settlement_date) as last_day
    from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly"
),

days as (
    select cast(unnest(generate_series(cast(first_day as timestamp), cast(last_day as timestamp), interval 1 day)) as date) as date_day
    from bounds
),

holidays as (
    select
        holiday_date,
        bool_or(division = 'england-and-wales') as is_bank_holiday_ew,
        bool_or(division = 'scotland') as is_bank_holiday_scotland,
        string_agg(distinct case when division = 'england-and-wales' then holiday_name end, ', ') as holiday_name
    from "energy"."staging"."stg_gov__bank_holidays"
    group by holiday_date
)

select
    cast(strftime(d.date_day, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    d.date_day,
    year(d.date_day) as year,
    quarter(d.date_day) as quarter,
    month(d.date_day) as month,
    monthname(d.date_day) as month_name,
    weekofyear(d.date_day) as iso_week,
    isodow(d.date_day) as day_of_week,
    dayname(d.date_day) as day_name,
    isodow(d.date_day) in (6, 7) as is_weekend,
    case
        when month(d.date_day) in (12, 1, 2) then 'Winter'
        when month(d.date_day) in (3, 4, 5) then 'Spring'
        when month(d.date_day) in (6, 7, 8) then 'Summer'
        else 'Autumn'
    end as season,
    coalesce(h.is_bank_holiday_ew, false) as is_bank_holiday_ew,
    coalesce(h.is_bank_holiday_scotland, false) as is_bank_holiday_scotland,
    h.holiday_name,
    cast(date_diff('minute',
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(d.date_day as timestamp)),
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(d.date_day + 1 as timestamp))) / 30 as integer) as expected_settlement_periods,
    cast(date_diff('minute',
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(d.date_day as timestamp)),
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(d.date_day + 1 as timestamp))) / 30 as integer) <> 48 as is_clock_change_day,
    case cast(date_diff('minute',
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(d.date_day as timestamp)),
        timezone('Europe/London', cast(d.date_day + 1 as timestamp))) / 30 as integer)
        when 46 then 'Clocks go forward'
        when 50 then 'Clocks go back'
    end as clock_change
from days as d
left join holidays as h on h.holiday_date = d.date_day

-- Main fact table. Grain: one row per GB settlement period (half hour).
-- Joins demand, national carbon intensity and generation mix, and GB weather.
select
    cast(strftime(d.settlement_date, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    d.settlement_date,
    d.settlement_period,
    d.period_start_utc,
    d.period_start_local,
    hour(d.period_start_local) as local_hour,
    strftime(d.period_start_local, '%H:%M') as local_time_label,
    d.national_demand_mw,
    d.underlying_demand_mw,
    d.transmission_system_demand_mw,
    d.embedded_wind_mw,
    d.embedded_solar_mw,
    d.embedded_wind_capacity_mw,
    d.embedded_solar_capacity_mw,
    d.pump_storage_pumping_mw,
    d.net_interconnector_flow_mw,
    c.intensity_actual,
    c.intensity_forecast,
    c.intensity_index,
    c.wind_pct,
    c.solar_pct,
    c.nuclear_pct,
    c.hydro_pct,
    c.biomass_pct,
    c.gas_pct,
    c.coal_pct,
    c.imports_pct,
    c.other_pct,
    c.wind_solar_pct,
    c.zero_carbon_pct,
    c.fossil_pct,
    w.temperature_c,
    w.wind_speed_kmh,
    w.solar_radiation_wm2,
    w.cloud_cover_pct
from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly" as d
left join "energy"."intermediate"."int_carbon__national_half_hourly" as c on c.period_start_utc = d.period_start_utc
left join "energy"."intermediate"."int_weather__gb_half_hourly" as w on w.period_start_utc = d.period_start_utc

select
    date_key as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "energy"."marts"."dim_date"
where date_key is not null
group by date_key
having count(*) > 1

-- The joins in the fact table must not drop or duplicate any demand period.
select
    (select count(*) from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly") as demand_periods,
    (select count(*) from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly") as fact_rows
where (select count(*) from "energy"."intermediate"."int_demand__half_hourly")
   <> (select count(*) from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly")

-- Cross-source check: NESO's net interconnector flow should rise when the
-- Carbon Intensity API shows a higher imports share. If the correlation is not
-- positive, the sign convention of the flow columns needs checking.
select corr(net_interconnector_flow_mw, imports_pct) as correlation
from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly"
having corr(net_interconnector_flow_mw, imports_pct) <= 0

-- Sanity check that the two Carbon Intensity API feeds agree with each other:
-- a higher zero-carbon share should go with lower intensity (strong negative correlation).
select corr(zero_carbon_pct, intensity_actual) as correlation
from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly"
having corr(zero_carbon_pct, intensity_actual) > -0.5

-- Warn if more than 1% of half hours older than 8 days have no temperature.
-- (Recent days are excluded because the weather archive lags by a few days.)
with recent_cut as (
    select max(settlement_date) - 8 as cut_date from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly"
),

coverage as (
    select
        count(*) as periods,
        count(*) filter (where temperature_c is null) as missing
    from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly", recent_cut
    where settlement_date <= cut_date
)

select *, round(100.0 * missing / periods, 2) as missing_pct
from coverage
where periods > 0 and 100.0 * missing / periods > 1

-- Daily summary. Grain: one row per settlement date. Used by the dashboard
-- and as the input to the next-day peak demand forecast.
with daily as (
    select
        settlement_date,
        count(*) as periods_reported,
        sum(national_demand_mw) * 0.5 / 1000 as demand_gwh,
        max(national_demand_mw) as peak_demand_mw,
        arg_max(period_start_local, national_demand_mw) as peak_time_local,
        min(national_demand_mw) as min_demand_mw,
        arg_min(period_start_local, national_demand_mw) as min_time_local,
        max(underlying_demand_mw) as peak_underlying_demand_mw,
        sum(embedded_solar_mw) * 0.5 / 1000 as embedded_solar_gwh,
        sum(embedded_wind_mw) * 0.5 / 1000 as embedded_wind_gwh,
        avg(intensity_actual) as avg_intensity,
        min(intensity_actual) as min_intensity,
        max(intensity_actual) as max_intensity,
        arg_min(period_start_local, intensity_actual) as cleanest_time_local,
        avg(wind_solar_pct) as avg_wind_solar_pct,
        avg(zero_carbon_pct) as avg_zero_carbon_pct,
        avg(gas_pct) as avg_gas_pct,
        avg(temperature_c) as avg_temperature_c,
        min(temperature_c) as min_temperature_c,
        avg(wind_speed_kmh) as avg_wind_speed_kmh
    from "energy"."marts"."fct_electricity_half_hourly"
    group by settlement_date
)

select
    dd.date_key,

    dd.year,

    dd.day_of_week,

    dd.is_weekend,
    dd.season,
    dd.is_bank_holiday_ew,
    dd.is_clock_change_day,
    dd.expected_settlement_periods,
    d.periods_reported,
    d.periods_reported = dd.expected_settlement_periods as is_complete_day,
    d.demand_gwh,
    d.peak_demand_mw,
    d.peak_time_local,
    d.min_demand_mw,
    d.min_time_local,
    d.peak_underlying_demand_mw,
    d.embedded_solar_gwh,
    d.embedded_wind_gwh,
    d.avg_intensity,
    d.min_intensity,
    d.max_intensity,
    d.cleanest_time_local,
